text.text_excerpt: Came here with a friend as they opened and I liked the place as soon as we walked in. To get in, you have to buzz the bartender to unlock the door. Without much signage, it's very easy to pass the place. They have a great happy hour with $1 off specialty cocktails, which are already priced pretty low. I had a few, all of which were great. My favorite is the $5 Sazerac. We also discovered they BBQ here daily too. We tried the bacon wrapped, cream cheese filled jalapeños as well as the meat plate; an order of ribs and brisket with two sides. The meat was quite good, but it was the sides killed it. Probably my favorite bar in the city. Excellent craft cocktails (and mocktails!), without pretension. Incredibly chill, laid-back atmosphere. Smoke free inside long before the city ordinance passed. Fun trivia/special interest event nights but also nights where the only events are a few people just hanging out and enjoying a pint or two. Amazing ginger beer on draft. The prices are reasonable and the jukebox is excellent. The bathrooms are not a total disaster like so many other bar bathrooms in the city. What more could you want in a friendly neighborhood bar? Brunch, you say? Look no further. Weekends they host one of the best brunches in the city... build your own biscuit sandwich or b...

What a pleasantly surprising experience this place was. I trotted in late one Saturday night looking for a quick drink to take the edge off of a very stressful week and maybe a nibble. I heard this place had quality cocktails at cheap prices and had my suspicions, but it all turned out to be true! I had the Baudin (bourbon, honey, lemon, hot sauce) and a Great Idea (vodka, zwack, bitters, lemon, ginger beer). Both were definitely quality crafted cocktails all for $6 each. Definitely a steal price on a speciality drink. You get an extra $1 off specialty cocktails during happy hour between 4-7pm daily as well.
